status: ninth aggregation slice: the dependency receipt reuses a dense structural variable cache and skips rebuilding an unchanged receipt; phase-level win, end-to-end within noise, and the interleaved standing check shows TodoMVC 5.9% ahead of K0 with NovyWave at +18.7%

change.cut: cached term variable lists and unchanged dependency receipts
change.what: a term's syntactic variables never change, so they are now cached per interned term id in a dense vector and reused by replace_binding_dependencies_from instead of walking every contributor on every fold. The freshly derived root set is compared with the retained receipt, and when it matches, both the dependent-list removals and the re-insertions are skipped.
change.why: the receipt was NovyWave's fourth-largest refresh bucket (11.9 ms) and it re-walked an unchanged contributor set on almost every fold.
change.refinement: the first version cached in a HashMap and cost TodoMVC 1.7% end to end; indexing by term id removed the hashing and left TodoMVC neutral (verified in a second interleaved A/B).

phase_probe_release.note: single observations; the TodoMVC deps reading moved against the change in this sample while its end-to-end result is neutral

interleaved_ab.protocol: eight alternating rounds, one process per observation, release evidence lane, cold fresh-process

vs_k0_producer.note: the K0 leg measures 548.5 ms in this window against its historical 530; the relative deltas are the interleaved result

position: the goal's mechanism is implemented and measured: destinations fold incrementally from a retained prefix, re-converge without re-merging the suffix, skip resolution and order rebuilds that change nothing, and now maintain their dependency receipt from a structural cache. TodoMVC is 5.9% ahead of the K0 producer on diagnostics; NovyWave is at +18.7% with a 93 ms refresh (resolve 19.2, order 14.5, merge 13.6, deps 7.9, occurs 11.7, collection/invalidation/commit ~5.7 and roughly 20 ms of loop overhead) against a non-refresh cost that is already at K0 parity.
next_decision: the residual NovyWave cost is per-fold verification of contributors whose raw terms are unchanged. Removing it soundly needs dependency-versioned contributor reuse: stamp each destination when the scheduler's binding-change walk reaches it, then reuse retained resolved terms when the stamp and raw inputs are unchanged. That is the retained-revision machinery the contract assigns to the successor goal, so it is recorded here as the hand-off decision rather than started inside this goal.
caveats: the slice claims a phase-level work reduction; its end-to-end effect is inside the host's noise band
the standing comparison uses the preserved K0 evidence binary in this window; the K0 leg runs 3% above its historical median
cold modes only; the warm path is the successor goal
